{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders with non-missing revenue
completed_non_missing = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'].notna())]

# Check for zero revenue in completed non-missing orders
zero_revenue_in_completed = completed_non_missing[completed_non_missing['revenue'] == 0]

# Report the count of zero-revenue completed orders
len(zero_revenue_in_completed)"}
